professional_summary.summary: I am a creative, self-starting technologist with a passion for problem-solving and assisting others. Proficient in full-stack development with a focus on server-side using Django. I love working on personal projects in my spare time, I tend to use: Django Rest Framework, Django-Filters, AWS, Postgres, CockroachDB, and Heroku. Developed CV hosting website which dynamically displays HTML via Django template, and JSON output via DRF. Developed a real estate listing website for real estate agents to be able to easily post listings and communicate with potential buyers and sellers. Developed software to easily maintain data relationship integrity when migrating records across environments. Developed a ticket-based support management system for KM Associates of NY, Inc. Developed software to gather Department of Buildings application data, including permit and violation information, utilizing the NYC OpenData API Built various websites for serviced-based local businesses.

employment_history.description: Instrumental in building and maintaining custom Salesforce org, M365 Active Directory, and other technology. Developed custom Salesforce org from concept to launch- working with stakeholders to leverage software systems to complement internal business processes. Designed a project weighing system that provided custom reports and operational recommendations to the Executive team. Created Django projects to extract and output specific data from multiple OpenDataNYC API endpoints into an easily consumable interface. Developed Python scripts to support business processes including data migration from legacy systems, and statistical analysis for marketing and advertising Participated in regular meetings with the Executive, Operations, and Project Management teams to determine business requirements for custom Salesforce apps. Actively participated in daily stand-ups, sprint and release planning, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies. Owned bug-fix solutions and ensured they were built and delivered to the end-users. Supported external Salesforce developers, focusing on day-to-day development, configuration, core infrastructure, and build deadlines.
Developed a Django server for 501(c) non-profit fundraising organization focused on restoring 122 East 83rd Street
Created software to automate advertising generation. Over 2 million ads were served using Python

Developed and deployed custom Python scripts to automate advertising for a large team of agents. 2x Douglas Elliman Chairman’s Gold Award Winner- Total Commission Earned: The LoRusso Team (2014, 2015)
